<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="800" height="300" viewBox="0 0 800 300">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="800" height="300" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- unmastered mass: v = 0.30 (x=280) to v = 1.0 (x=700) -->
  <rect x="280" y="88" width="420" height="44" fill="#e9e9e9" stroke="#bdbdbd" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="490" y="116" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#444444" text-anchor="middle">(1 − p) = unmastered mass</text>

  <!-- number line -->
  <line x1="100" y1="165" x2="700" y2="165" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="100" y1="156" x2="100" y2="174" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="700" y1="156" x2="700" y2="174" stroke="#333333" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="100" y="196" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#444444" text-anchor="middle">0</text>
  <text x="700" y="196" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#444444" text-anchor="middle">1</text>

  <!-- dots -->
  <circle cx="280" cy="165" r="5.5" fill="#333333"/>
  <circle cx="364" cy="165" r="5.5" fill="#333333"/>
  <text x="272" y="150" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#444444" text-anchor="end">p = 0.30</text>
  <text x="372" y="150" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#444444" text-anchor="start">p<tspan dy="-5" font-size="11">−</tspan><tspan dy="5"> = 0.44</tspan></text>

  <!-- arrow: predict shift -->
  <line x1="280" y1="204" x2="352" y2="204" stroke="#2563eb" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <polygon points="366,204 350,197 350,211" fill="#2563eb"/>
  <text x="323" y="232" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#2563eb" text-anchor="middle">+0.16 = (1 − p) × T,  with T = 0.20</text>

  <!-- caption -->
  <text x="400" y="272" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" fill="#555555" text-anchor="middle">belief that the student has mastered the skill</text>
</svg>
result.notes:
The figure is correct and clean: the number line spans 0→1 (x=100→700), the shaded unmastered mass runs exactly from x=280 (v=0.30) to x=700 (v=1.0), dots sit at the proportional positions 280 and 364, and the single blue arrow shows the +0.16 predict shift. No overlaps, nothing clipped.

**Notes for the teacher:** The figure shows one number line for belief P(mastered), with the light-gray block marking the unmastered mass (1−p) from 0.30 to 1.0, and a single blue arrow from p=0.30 to p⁻=0.44 illustrating that the predict step moves only that unmastered mass by (1−p)×T = 0.16. Dot positions are exactly proportional to 0.30 and 0.44 on the 0–1 axis; the superscript minus in "p⁻" is rendered via a tspan for reliable display.
